The base path that contains all of the inputs, outputs, and virtual
    environment used during the training process. Outputs are produced in
    specific subdirectories depending on the type of output file.
The name of the subdirectory that contains all outputs produced by this node.

The name of the training run. If this node is being wedged out to perform
    different training runs with different settings, this parameter can create a per-wedge output directory.

The path to the directory that contains all ML models, tests, and plots for
    the current training run. By default, this parameter is derived from the

parameters, but can
    be modified to a custom directory path.
